Container.Name: Fixit
Container.Overview: Fixit is a small, self-hosted help desk for your home. Family members report things that need fixing (wifi down, a leak, a bug in the kitchen) from their phone, with photos. You triage, reply, and track each ticket to done. Includes reminders when you're waiting on someone, automatic closing of resolved tickets, phone push notifications, and an installable web app. Open the web UI after install to create the admin account.
Container.Requires: Phone push notifications and installing the app need HTTPS. Put Fixit behind a reverse proxy (such as Nginx Proxy Manager) with a domain and certificate, and set Public URL to that address.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Config / data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded photos and generated keys. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The https address people use, e.g. https://fixit.example.com. Used in notification links and passkeys.

Config.Name: Ticket prefix
Config.Description: Shown before ticket numbers, e.g. HOME-42.

Config.Name: Resolved auto-close (hours)
Config.Description: Resolved tickets close on their own after this many hours unless reopened.

Config.Name: Reminder interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to remind the requester while a ticket is Waiting on requester.

Config.Name: Reminders before closing
Config.Description: Reminders (counting the first) before a Waiting on requester ticket closes on its own.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional. Set SMTP host and From address to also send email notifications.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
